4 cron dọn dẹp (cleanup-notifications, auth-cleanup, hard-delete-workspaces, hard-delete-profiles)
KHỐI 3 — 4 cron dọn dẹp hàng ngày
KHỐI 4 — cron review-janitor 20h UTC → Inngest reviewJanitor
send lỗi chỉ log — vẫn trả 200, janitor (d) sẽ re-enqueue
[chữ ký HMAC sai hoặc lệch quá 5 phút]
KHỐI 6 — 2 fn Inngest còn lại (nguồn event ngoài F16)

svg.text: task.findMany deadline trong 1h/24h, status in OVERDUE_ELIGIBLE_STATUSES
task.update status = Quá hạn (deadline đã qua)
notification.findMany emailSentAt null, isArchived false, take 50
GET kèm x-cron-secret (auth-cleanup dùng safeEqual timingSafeEqual)
cleanup-notifications — notification.deleteMany archived hơn 30d, read hơn 90d
auth-cleanup — deleteMany EmailVerificationToken expired, PasswordResetOTP expired/consumed 7d, LoginAttempt hơn 90d
hard-delete-workspaces — audit workspace.hard_deleted rồi workspace.delete cascade (hardDeleteAfter đã qua)
hard-delete-profiles — audit profile.hard_deleted rồi profile.delete cascade
(a) uploadSession hết hạn → expireInflightUpload — UPLOADING sang FAILED + abort R2 multipart
(b) redrive UPLOADED kẹt quá 15p → reconcileStuckUploadedVersion → driveCompletion
(c) PROCESSING kẹt quá 20p → getMuxAsset đối chiếu
deleteMuxAsset asset kẹt (chỉ khi đã FAILED)
(d) webhookEvent processedAt null tuổi 1h..7d → re-send review/mux.event.received
(e) purgeExpiredTrash — xóa Mux + R2 + DB rows trash quá 30 ngày
200 duplicated true — không bắn lại event
applyMuxReady — flip PROCESSING sang READY + reviewState AWAITING_REVIEW + currentVersionId + clear statusId approved
revokeClientExposureOnNewVersion + syncTaskFromReviewEvent (task sang trạng thái submitted)
applyMuxErrored — flip PROCESSING/UPLOADED sang FAILED + errorMessage
step mark-processed — processedAt = now (ghi CUỐI để retry an toàn)
flip PROCESSING sang FAILED — nội dung tệp không hợp lệ
store muxAssetId (guard PROCESSING + null, xóa asset thừa nếu thua cuộc)
load-state — reviewState khớp + version là head, không thì skip superseded
